title: Live role detail: output tail, tokens and cost, ASCII charts and animations, bell

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-23: a progress bar and more animation for running relays, and the activity sparkline of the sketch at docs/dashboard.md:315-325. Decisions: (a) the bar measures pipeline stages done (implementer, reviewer, gate, plus architect when the run has one), with the running stage's cell pulsing and a fix round re-opening its stage; (b) a ticker at 4 frames a second runs only while the Overview shows a running run or its pane is open, otherwise ork blocks on input as today; (c) the sparkline plots vendor stream events per 30-second bucket over the last 5 minutes for the running role, kept in daemon memory, not in run.json. Builds on S55 (the run tree) and on S97 (pipeline, round, last heard). The bell in S07's note is not in this slice until the owner decides what rings it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/runner.go` (Request, Result): an optional per-event hook so the engine can count stream events; `internal/agent/claude/run.go` (Spec.OnEvent) and `internal/agent/codex/codex.go` (:36, :187) already deliver events to the adapter: pass them through `internal/daemon/runner.go`.
- `internal/engine/` (new `activity.go`) and its test: a ring of 10 buckets of 30 seconds per running role, in memory; `Engine.Snapshot` or a new accessor exposes it; no run.json field.
- `internal/daemon/wire.go`, `handlers.go`, `internal/source/source.go`: carry the series on the engine run as a *proposed* `activity` field (omitempty).
- `internal/tui/progress.go` (new) and `progress_test.go`: the stage bar and the sparkline drawing, with ASCII fallbacks.
- `internal/tui/model.go`, `view.go`: the 4 fps ticker only while a run is visible (use the existing After seam, model.go:41, so tests inject time); `internal/tui/runtree.go` and `overview.go`: draw the bar, pulse and sparkline.
- `testdata/golden/` (colour and monochrome); `docs/dashboard.md:315-345` and `docs/design.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestStageBarFillsFinishedRoles: implementer done, reviewer running, gate waiting draws [##~...] style cells as the sketch; an architect adds a cell; a fix round re-opens the implementer cell and keeps the round shown.
- TestRunningCellPulsesWithTheTicker: two ticker frames give two different glyphs for the running cell; the finished cells do not change.
- TestTickerRunsOnlyWhileARunIsVisible: with no running run on screen no timer command is returned; with one, a tick re-arms; closing the pane and leaving the Overview stops it.
- TestEngineCountsStreamEventsPerThirtySeconds: a fake runner emits events at known times (injected clock); the ring holds the counts of the last 10 buckets and drops older ones.
- TestSparklineDrawsTheBuckets: counts map to the eight block glyphs scaled to the window maximum; an all-zero window draws the lowest glyph; the ASCII fallback uses ._-=+# style cells.
- TestSparklineIsNotWrittenToRunJSON: the run record is unchanged.
- TestStalledRoleShowsAFlatLine: no events for 5 minutes gives a flat sparkline before the stale cutoff.
- Golden views at 100x30 and 80x24, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first and watch them fail (the injected clock and the After seam keep them deterministic). 2. Count events in the engine from a Request hook; keep the ring in memory. 3. Carry the series on the wire as a proposed field. 4. Draw the bar and sparkline with ASCII fallbacks (internal/brand locale check). 5. Add the ticker, armed only while a run is visible. 6. Update docs. 7. go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff. This is a UI slice: it gets the UI pass (r14, rule u10).
Decided 2026-10-23 (owner): stage bar, 4 fps ticker only while a run is visible, sparkline of stream events per 30s. Not in this slice: the bell; a budget bar (S65); any write.

Corrections and owner decisions of 2026-10-23/24 from the S07 preflight. Docs anchors: the sketch cited as docs/dashboard.md:315-325 no longer exists; use dashboard.md:128-129 (Running), :392 (role-detail list), :454-466 (the S97 paragraph that says no progress bar, ticker or sparkline: update it) and design.md ~:847. Files added: engine.Request gets a vendor-neutral `OnEvent func()` (internal/engine/runner.go), set at internal/engine/round.go:223 beside OnStart; internal/daemon/runner.go:31 and :75 map claude.Spec.OnEvent and codex.Spec.OnEvent to it; daemon.engineRuns (runs.go:775) is rebuilt per snapshot, so the series is added at runs.go:818 and source.EngineRun (source.go:175); the activity ring has its own mutex (Engine.mu is held for the whole Run); the daemon computes the 10-bucket series against its own clock at snapshot time, so the sparkline is as fresh as the snapshot poll. A source-less started-elsewhere ledger run has no events and no sparkline; its bar still comes from steps. (1) TICKER: ork already re-arms a 1 s schedule tick forever (model.go:215-225); leave it alone. Add a separate 4 fps frame ticker: a new Config.FrameAfter seam sending a new frameMsg, 250 ms, armed once, only while the Overview shows a Running-section or live-ledger row or a pane is open on a live run, disarmed on the next frameMsg when nothing qualifies; treeFrame advances on frameMsg only (the shared After seam cannot serve it: tui_test.go:117 maps every After to tickMsg). The HUMAN CHECK reads: no 4 fps timer when idle. (2) ASCII: a stdlib check in cmd (LC_ALL, then LC_CTYPE, then LANG must contain UTF-8 or utf8) sets Config.ASCII; it affects only the sparkline glyphs (blocks ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ vs ._-=+#); the bar is always ASCII; the existing ✓/✗ stay; goldens stay unicode in colour and mono, plus one ASCII golden at 100x30. (3) BAR: 2-column cells in brackets, ASCII only: done `##`, waiting `..`, failed `!!`, running pulses `~~ ~= == =~` by frame (finished cells never change); implementer done, reviewer running, gate waiting is `[##~~..]`; an architect run has 4 cells. Overview Running rows: the bar goes after elapsed and is dropped last when narrow (order: heard, pipeline, details, then bar); the S97 pipeline text stays. Pane: a bar line above the pipeline line, then a line `activity <10 glyphs>  last 5m` under last heard. Monochrome relies on glyphs, not style. A stopped, paused, stale or ended run shows a frozen bar (running cell `~~`, no pulse) and no sparkline. (4) FIX ROUNDS: a new implementer round re-opens the implementer cell as running with `r2` after the bar and resets reviewer, gate and architect cells to waiting (a role's latest step older than the latest implementer step counts as waiting; pipeline() at internal/tui/relayboard.go:76-100 does not reset today). The sparkline is the run's currently running role: one `activity []int` of 10 counts, oldest first, bucket edges at wall-clock 30 s boundaries, omitted when no role runs, starting empty at each new role round. Nothing is open.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/source ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] While a relay runs, ork shows the stage bar, a pulsing running cell and the sparkline; idle ork uses no timer.
